app_fee.value: The Arts & Sciences graduate application fee is $50, non-refundable. The CDSP fee is also $50.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable processing fee of $50 is required for application for admission to a graduate program in Arts & Sciences.

fee_waiver.value: Only McNair Scholars, Fulbright Scholars, Peace Corps, Teach for America or AmeriCorps members and graduates of Minority Serving Institutions can request a fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: The following applicants may request waivers of the application fee | Fulbright Scholars: Send to the Office of Graduate Studies a copy of the letter notifying you of your selection as a Fulbright Fellow

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required by any Arts & Sciences program; you may send them if you choose.
gre_general.quote: Scores from the GRE General Test and/or the GRE Subject Tests are not required by any graduate department or program in Arts & Sciences | The optional submission of GRE scores is allowed, unless otherwise indicated by a department or program

toefl_min.value: The graduate school gives no TOEFL minimum score; the test is required if English is not your first language, and programs may set their own score.

ielts_min.value: The graduate school gives no IELTS minimum band; the test is required if English is not your first language, and programs may set their own score.

english_waiver.value: India is not named. A waiver needs the program's recommendation and a transcript showing that the degree was taught in English, so an English-medium Indian degree is conditional.
english_waiver.quote: Upon the recommendation of the graduate program to which you are applying, the TOEFL/IELTS requirement can be waived for applicants who will have received a degree from a college or university in which English is the primary language of instruction | A transcript is required as evidence of successful instruction in English as a primary language

notes: Graduate school rules for Arts & Sciences; CDSP (Applied Science, CS, Physics) lists the same $50 fee, optional GRE and waiver rule. The Batten School (Marine Science PhD) sets its own fee, GRE and English rules on its program record.
